runtime.requestLimit: public like create/cancel and admin like status reject request bodies beyond maxRequestBytes before JSON parse
runtime.accessIntegration: public like status/create/cancel require readable content when content.access is enabled
runtime.adminListLimit: admin like counter list clamps request limit by maxAdminListRows
runtime.adminStats: like.stats returns content count, aggregate like count and record status counts for admin diagnostics
runtime.adminStatsUi: ability page renders like.stats as a metric table
